description: What a canonical driver in this repository may call. One driver per device, one source of truth, running on linux-edge hosts.

linux-edge.description: FTW (gopher-lua) and Blixt L1 (luajit). Both run on Linux-class hardware, so a driver here is not written to a memory budget.

alias_note: Each of these is a second name for a function that already exists. host.decode_u32 and host.decode_i32 are big-endian by definition, so the _be spellings decode the same bytes. FTW renamed modbus_write_multiple to modbus_write_multi in its own drivers, and baselines/ftw/drivers/ferroamp_modbus.lua records that rename in a comment. Two names for one function is how a canonical driver stops being portable: which spelling a driver calls decides which host it runs on. The aliases are recorded here so the drift is visible, and the left-hand spellings should disappear as drivers are made canonical.

pending.description: Called by FTW's bundled drivers and not yet part of the contract. Importing a bundled driver that needs one of these requires deciding first: define it for every linux-edge host, or rewrite the driver without it.
